label: heart-s4-c1

analysis.note: Ablations remove a child's readout from the logit (zero and mean ablation give the same AUC because readouts enter additively). Linear replacement = least-squares refit of the child's logit contribution on its own raw inputs. The hidden block adds +0.0095 train AUC over the linear core; the fixed-defect/normal-sugar gate carries most of it (0.008). The cp:4 and slope:3 indicators are exactly affine on their binary inputs (R2 1.00).

resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. The one real interaction (fixed thallium defect AND normal fasting sugar, gate 2065) rests on 10 training patients and may be partly noise-fitted. Hidden nodes 1754 (cp:4) and 3504 (slope:3) are exactly affine on their binary inputs, so they are re-parameterisations of linear terms, not mechanisms. Counter-directional signs reported, not explained: fbs:1 -0.58 in the linear core, and the gate making a fixed defect protective for normal-sugar patients.
tool_bugs: No v3 tool bugs met. compute_shap on all 242 train rows (about a minute) gives mean |SHAP| about 0.001 to the six unconnected inputs, which have exactly zero effect (KernelSHAP sampling noise). Input fan-out splits (-10, -11, -15, -21, -7) taken from the topology. The agent sandbox refused shell loops calling uv with variables, so tools were called through a small Python subprocess wrapper in scratch (same species_leads/xn.py).
summary: Essentially logistic regression: 19 direct edges (logit SD 4.55; train AUC 0.933 alone; ca +2.25, slope:2 +1.12, sex:1 +0.90) plus four additive hidden readouts (logit SD 0.86) to 0.942. The one meaningful nonlinearity is an AND gate 2065 = 3.64*[thal:6 AND fbs=0] read out -1.08, lowering the logit by 3.9 for the 10 fixed-defect patients with normal fasting sugar (core mean predicted 0.83, disease rate 50%). The cp:4 and slope:3 hidden indicators are exactly affine on their binary inputs and a floored thalach relay is near-inert. Same gate and linear core as the 10-seed heart-s4 record (key 9650, gen 38); here cp:4 and slope:3 indicators replace that genome's cp:2 indicator.
